correctness.rationale: At frozen RESULT.md and check_linear.py, the line-graph identity F=B^tB over characteristic 2 is exact: B is incidence of K_{a,b} minus one edge. The rank of B onto even vertex-coordinate vectors and the parity-core decomposition of Q=BB^t into (2,2), (3,2), (3,3) cores and scalar sectors establish all a,b>=2, q=2^h. Core rank sequences determine J3/J2/J1, J5 and the unique J2(1) as stated; finite-field kernel counting yields exact time layers. Independently constructed a GF(2) adjacency matrix and computed power ranks at (2,2),(2,3),(3,3),(4,4),(3,8),(7,6),(9,9), matching [E,a+b-2,1,0], [E,a+b-2,stable], or [E,o+s-1,s+1,s,s-1,s-2,s-2] as appropriate. Finite cases corroborate, not prove, the all-size decomposition. The line-graph diagonal cancellation depends critically on characteristic 2.
